sub_sector.value: Fixed annuities; pension risk transfer; life insurance

financial_business_type.detail: Issues fixed indexed annuities, group annuities for pension risk transfer, and life insurance policies.

revenue_driver.detail: Earns investment income and collects premiums on insurance and annuity contracts.
